name: LUT Cache Hashing Fix for In-Place Edits
definition: Fixes stale transmittance and multiscattering LUT caches after in-place medium edits. Previously, the cache hashed the medium's handle, which an in-place asset edit keeps, so the LUTs went stale until a periodic rebuild every 240 frames, while sky-view and aerial LUTs already read the new medium (causing a washed-out sky for up to 4 s).
